title: Turkish-Style Grilled Adana Kebap
description: A classic Turkish dish featuring marinated Adana meat grilled to perfection. Serve with a side of turkish bread and salad for a flavorful meal.

ingredients.name: Adana Kebap meat
ingredients.notes: Make sure to buy from a reputable source.

ingredients.name: Turkish bread
ingredients.notes: Crusty bread is a must for sopping up the juices.

ingredients.name: Pecan oil
ingredients.notes: For a rich and nutty flavor.

instructions: 2. In a large bowl, whisk together luscious yogurt, paprika, salt, black pepper, garlic, and cumin.
3. Add the Adana Kebap meat to the marinade and mix well to coat.
4. Let the meat marinate for at least 30 minutes, or up to 2 hours in the refrigerator.
5. Remove the meat from the marinade and shake off any excess.
6. Brush the grill with pecan oil to prevent sticking.
7. Grill the Adana Kebap meat for 5-7 minutes per side, or until cooked to your desired level of doneness.
8. Let the meat rest for 5 minutes before slicing.
9. Serve the Adana Kebap with sliced Turkish bread, salad, and a dollop of luscious yogurt on top.
10. Garnish with chopped parsley and serve immediately.
